title: Rename Travel Tools shop tile and link it to the existing Shop route

requirements.summary: Rename the Travel Tools shop tile to “TravelButts shop” and make it navigate to the existing Shop route used by the app navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Travel Tools grid, the tile label is “TravelButts shop” (matching capitalization and spacing exactly).
Clicking the “TravelButts shop” tile opens the app’s Shop page (the same route used elsewhere in the app for Shop), not “/coming-soon”.
No other labels elsewhere in the UI are changed as part of this rename.

file_operations.description: Update the specific Travel Tools tile entry currently titled “Print on Demand Travel Products” to use the title exactly “TravelButts shop”, and change its navigation target from the coming-soon path to the existing Shop route used by the app (align with the hash route used by Shop navigation, e.g. “#shop”). Ensure only this tile’s label is changed and no other UI labels are modified.
